stem:
Bina sketches a quadrilateral with three interior angles marked $90^\circ$ and wonders whether the fourth interior angle can be $80^\circ$.

Which claim is correct?

options.text: No: the four interior angles sum to $360^\circ$, so three right angles force the fourth to be $90^\circ$ as well.
Call the figure an "interior angle" only, and skip the quadrilateral angle-sum.
The fourth angle of $80^\circ$ forces the three right-angle marks, so start from $80^\circ$ and ignore the $360^\circ$ sum.
Answer "yes" only because the stem prints the numeral $90$ three times.

teacher.key_rationale: Interior angles of a quadrilateral sum to 360°, so three 90° angles force a fourth 90°. Relabeling as "interior angle" alone drops the sum. Saying 80° forces the right angles reverses the constraint. Grabbing the printed 90 misses the sum hinge.
